notes: SPECIAL CASE: the worked example of spec/offline-verification.md. One weave.key.declared record signed by its own key, an L0 manifest signed by that key, every byte canonical, nothing else. The byte-level manual sha256sum/openssl procedure still walks it end to end; record trust comes from the local trust input (--keys @keyset, revision-2 R2): without it the same bytes are unverifiable (see container/self-attested-root-untrusted).
